scope.summary: Author the canonical repeating-fill primitive StudioPattern (schema id hsk.studio.pattern@1): a tile with tile type (grid, brick-by-row, brick-by-column, hex-by-row, hex-by-column), brick/hex offset, tile size (with move-with-art), spacing, and overlap order; a pattern fill MAY be transformed (move/scale/rotate) independently of the object it fills (AI Pattern Options + transform-pattern-independently). Patterns are stored as named swatches where the source suites did so. Reference canonical StudioPattern from MT-002; never fork.
expected_tests: live: pattern fill transforms (move/scale/rotate) independently of filled object; stored as named swatch

spec_clauses.spec_clause_text: [STU-COL-012] `StudioPattern` (schema id `hsk.studio.pattern@1`) is the canonical repeating-fill primitive: a tile with tile type (grid, brick-by-row, brick-by-column, hex-by-row, hex-by-column), brick/hex offset, tile size (with move-with-art), spacing, and overlap order; a pattern fill MAY be transformed (move/scale/rotate) independently of the object it fills (provenance: Illustrator Pattern Options + transform-pattern-independently). Patterns are stored as named swatches where the source suites did so. --- ### 4. Color-Management Operations (proof / separation / prepress)

[STU-CON-001] CANONICAL PRIMITIVES. The canonical Studio primitive set is defined in 14.3 [STU-DOC-002]. Each primitive's field-level struct is authored here as implementation lands; the per-domain catalogs (14.4-14.15) reference these primitives and MUST NOT fork them. Newly discovered primitives MUST be added here (not invented locally in a domain catalog) via governed spec enrichment.

implementation_notes.naming: Vendor product names are provenance only. Studio ships Handshake-native names per [STU-SECTION-003].
implementation_notes.database: SurrealDB with the EventLedger is the only durable authority. SQLite, libSQL, Turso and PostgreSQL are forbidden, including in tests and dev caches.
implementation_notes.engine_split: GPU, WGSL and compute live in the studio-engine crate behind its traits. handshake_core must never gain a GPU dependency.
implementation_notes.routing: Navigation extends the existing address and bus seams. No new router.
implementation_notes.worktree: Code paths resolve against the WP-KERNEL-012 worktree, never main.

validator_focus: Confirm every acceptance row traces to a sentence in the cited spec clause carried in implementation_notes. A row with no spec basis is a fabrication.
Reject any row still carrying proof_target_status REQUIRED: it has no proof of its own.
Reject scaffold-only proof: at least one proof command must drive the executable runtime rather than a fixture the implementer authored.
Where the contract touches numeric parameters, confirm hard and soft bounds are stored as separate values and an unknown bound is stored as unknown, never mirrored.

resource_privacy_obligation.rule: Resources this contract reads, derives, caches or exports stay inside the authenticated operator's scope. No cross-identity read path may be introduced.

patch_provenance.preserved: The original acceptance prose is kept verbatim at scope.acceptance_criteria_original. No clause, scope decision, path list or obligation from the original contract was removed.
